svg.text: Hotspot: where Top 6 concentrate a ship or habit more than the Rest
Each dot is the centre of one laid smoke, team-normalized (north-spawn teams mirrored north-south). Outline = the spot (solid = signature, dashed = lead).
Lead: flank smoke lines, own-side rim of cap C, centre
Cruiser inside: 12 of 13 Top 6 smokes (Moskva 5, Brisbane 4).
2nd destroyer: position recorded 9 of 13, forward of the smoke 5 (Ragnar 3).
